_readme: The curated b-roll library. See backend/utils/clipperLibrary.js for why it exists.
Clips themselves are gitignored - drop the file in this folder, then describe it here.
Every clip needs a licence, and durationSec is what lets a beat be split into shots.
tags are what the stock search matches against, so write what is ON SCREEN,
not what the clip is about: 'typhoon runway afterburner takeoff', never 'power'.
